issues.description: Method attend(course:) parameter type mismatch: the Problem Statement requires Developer.attend(course:) to accept an optional Course? and explicitly instructs using optional binding to handle a nil course. The Template (Sources/DeveloperLib/Developer.swift) declares the extension method signature as func attend(course: Course?) (line 34). The Solution (Sources/DeveloperLib/Developer.swift) declares the method as func attend(course: Course) (line 42) — a non-optional parameter. This inconsistency forces students to reconcile differing signatures and hides the optional-binding behavior required by the exercise, which is pedagogically important.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution's attend signature match the problem statement and template: change the solution's method to func attend(course: Course?) and update its body to use optional binding (if let course = course) before checking course.name.lowercased().contains("swift"). Increment monthsOfSwiftExperience only when a non-nil course is provided (set to 1 if previously nil, otherwise +1) and print the same successful participation message. This preserves the intended optional-binding exercise and keeps all artifacts consistent.
